summary.text: Ethan Manning is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 23, has served since 2018, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ethan Manning was born in Peru, Indiana, was raised near Macy on his family farm, and graduated from North Miami High School in 2010.
He went on to earn a B.S. in business management from Western Governors University.

His work experience includes being a broker and auctioneer for Carriger Oldfather Realty, owning the family farm Manning Cattle Company, managing Manning Auctions, and owning and managing residential properties.

Manning served on the Miami County Council, where he was elected council president, and in 2015 he was appointed to the Indiana State Board of Registration for Professional Engineers, serving as its president in 2018.
He assumed office in the Indiana House on November 7, 2018, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election he faces Democrat Austin Meives.
For 2025-2026, he was assigned to the House Public Policy Committee, which he chairs, and the Rules and Legislative Procedures Committee.
